name: meeting-card
title: MeetingCard compound widget — title + datetime + location + optional description + optional presence chips

public_api.constructor:
MeetingCard({
  required MeetingsEntity meeting,
  VoidCallback? onTap,
  int? totalPresences,
  int? confirmedPresences,
  bool showDescription = false,
})

conventions_reminder: All colors/spacings via design tokens — no hardcoded values
Double quotes on all string literals
ISO 8601 datetime parsed via DateTime.tryParse; invalid/null returns 'Data nao definida'
DateTime formatted via DateFormat('dd MMM yyyy • HH:mm', 'pt_BR') from intl package
acceptance_criteria: flutter analyze passes on meeting_card.dart (0 errors)
Public API: MeetingCard({required MeetingsEntity meeting, VoidCallback? onTap, int? totalPresences, int? confirmedPresences, bool showDescription = false})
Renders meeting name (or 'Reuniao' fallback) + AppBadge with meetingCode if non-null
Renders datetime row with Icons.event_rounded + _formatDateTime output
Renders location row with Icons.location_on_rounded if meeting.location is non-null
Renders description (maxLines: 2) if showDescription && meeting.description != null

Renders presence chips row when totalPresences && confirmedPresences are both non-null: AppChip('$confirmedPresences/$totalPresences presencas', soft, primary) + status chip (Confirmada/Pendente/Parcial)
DateTime parsing handles null and invalid gracefully (returns 'Data nao definida')
No hardcoded color or spacing values
completion_summary: Implemented MeetingCard compound widget: AppCard wrapper with title + optional AppBadge for meetingCode, datetime row (Icons.event_rounded + DateFormat pt-BR), optional location row, optional description row (showDescription flag), and optional presence chips row with status logic (Confirmada/Pendente/Parcial). All via design tokens, handles null/invalid datetime gracefully.
